limitations: Current private Node TCP/IPC verification diagnostic only. No product/global acceptance or release authorization.

Guard applies only to Node code that installs/inherits the monkeypatch, such as NODE_OPTIONS-inheriting processes. No OS sandbox, UDP, noninheriting/native child, preexisting descriptor, or arbitrary hostile-code confinement attestation.

Independent probes ran in one Node v22.23.2 process per command, no child agents or spawned workloads. Only numeric loopback TCP and IPC inside outputRoot; synthetic lookup callbacks; zero nonliteral DNS requests. External/DNS/PG/Docker/provider/npm/install/full-suite execution was not performed.
Original qualification and five-file results are supplied evidence, not independently rerun. Supplied logs cannot establish comprehensive traffic absence.
Input bytes were independently hashed now. source-before/source-after and 81 sourceBindings are metadata, not an independent historical source rehash. Referenced live paths were not read.

Source inventories omit two bound docs and one SQL migration by runner selection. 78 represented bindings agree; 7 provided source copies agree. The absent three are not independently verified historical sources.

The smoke assertion remains failed: expected ECONNREFUSED, received CVG_GLOBAL_TEST_NETWORK_BLOCKED. Zero pending/todo test cases; smoke-internal SKIPPED expectations after the failing assertion were not reached.
JSON suite counters 11 total/9 passed/2 failed coexist with five file entries (4 passed/1 failed) and 28 assertions (27 passed/1 failed); do not equate suite counters with file counts.

Two initial synthetic harness attempts failed (overstrict DNS stub, then wrong literal lookup return shape plus unhandled accepted-socket ECONNRESET); scripts/logs retained. Final harness fixed all:true shape and accepted-socket error handling; its exit 1 is four real expectation failures, not a harness exception.

No claim of exhaustive options/address-family/race coverage. Ownership uses append-only listen/close rows, pid liveness and address/port/path equality; PID reuse, thread lifetime, path alias/replacement and registry trust are not fully qualified.
